name: Dark Triad Test
description: Measures three socially aversive personality traits: Narcissism, Machiavellianism, and Psychopathy. Short Dirty Dozen (12 items) and SD3 (27 items) are widely used research versions.
reputation: Widely used in personality and organizational research; free short versions available.
notes: Self-report of antisocial traits susceptible to underreporting; short versions sacrifice validity.
